name: Udou Aira
source:
"You'll look fabulous in whatever dress you pick, Ren..."

[url=/c87520/]Ren[/url]'s senpai from middle school. She's a sucker for the ladies and will always turn on the charm around them. But there's something about her that has [url=/c87518/]Akuru[/url] watching her back...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644150/OshiRabu_Waifus_Over_Husbandos_Loveordie/]Steam[/url]]
